title: Equal-amplitude Basquin life with Goodman mean-stress correction
source: Basquin S-N relation and Goodman correction as stated in Shigley, Mechanical Engineering Design, fatigue chapter; values are direct substitutions.

quantities.reason: The record contains two counted cycles of amplitude 4 Pa and mean 6 Pa. N=100(10/4)^3, so 2/N=0.00128 exactly.
The record duration is 4 s and the independent damage is 0.00128, so duration/damage=3125 s.
Goodman changes amplitude to 4/(1-6/20)=40/7 Pa. Two cycles with N=100(10/(40/7))^3 give damage 0.003731778425655976.
The record duration is 4 s; 4/0.003731778425655976=1071.875 s by the same closed-form Miner convention.
